mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a grid like structure which has at its head English, this is then subdivided in the next layer to American English (AE) Branch and British English (BE) Branch."
Superimposed on the map is a grid like structure which has at its head English, this is then subdivided in the next layer to American English (AE) Branch and British English (BE) Branch.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a process that terminates in linguicide or the death of a first language where and when the second language becomes so dominant as to replace the first."
Replacive Bilinguals Replacive bilingualism is a process that terminates in linguicide or the death of a first language where and when the second language becomes so dominant as to replace the first.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a situation whereby the acquisition of a second language does not affect the first language in any negative ways."
Additive bilingualism is a situation whereby the acquisition of a second language does not affect the first language in any negative ways.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ refers to the bilinguals who acquire the second language „naturally, through contextual demands‟ (Edwards 2006: 11)."
Primary bilingualism generally refers to the bilinguals who acquire the second language „naturally, through contextual demands‟ (Edwards 2006: 11).

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is used as a foreign language in countries and or communities where it is neither a native or first language nor is it a second or third language."
English as a Foreign Language (EFL) English is used as a foreign language in countries and or communities where it is neither a native or first language nor is it a second or third language.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ can be defined as „the ability to use the L 2 accurately, appropriately, and flexibly‟."
Communicative competence can be defined as „the ability to use the L 2 accurately, appropriately, and flexibly‟.
fib: ______ is one of the West Germanic languages that were used in early medieval England.
The English language is one of the West Germanic languages that were used in early medieval England.
______ are a sub-field of Indo-European languages.
Germanic languages are a sub-field of Indo-European languages.
______ is used to show racial or tribal solidarity or sentiment.
Code-switching is used to show racial or tribal solidarity or sentiment.
______ means pushing the frontiers of the target language especially in the area of writing.
The elaboration process invariably means pushing the frontiers of the target language especially in the area of writing.
______ is defined as all the activities or efforts geared towards enhancing communication in a bilingual or multilingual society.
Language planning and policy is defined as all the activities or efforts geared towards enhancing communication in a bilingual or multilingual society.
